title: Projective bundle formula for Chow homology of finite locally free modules
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: Injectivity requires successively extracting every coefficient by Chern-class cap and proper pushforward. Surjectivity must be built by reduction to irreducible support and induction on the base dimension, followed by an affine-stratum filtration of the trivialized projective bundle and explicit lifts of cycle coefficients.
